tool_args.rationale: Fit the guided subcritical siphon and signed square-root branch numerically, allowing the full fallback parameter bounds. Fresh confirmation will test whether the stationary model generalizes.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows identify the three parameters of the guided square-root branch; confirmation is more economical.
The observed gradient range is subcritical, with no available high-gradient probe or evidence for a threshold term.
The observed monotone-concave signature and gradient dependence favor the guided siphon model.
